item.description:
Crema 1.5.1

A maintenance release: two fixes and a translation pass. Nothing about how the app works changed.

Fixed

  • The style tiles told the truth about which style they mean. The tiles in Settings › General — and the ones in the welcome tour — were seeded with the main display's resolved style. If that display carried a per-display override, the override showed up selected in the control that speaks for every screen, claiming a declaration nobody had made, one row above the row already reporting it correctly as that display's own.
  • Helium no longer surfaces as a music player. YouTube playing in Helium reached the notch as if it were a player, because a Chromium fork gets its own bundle identifier and slipped past the browser filter. Helium is now filtered like every other browser, so it only appears when you have asked for browser media.

Improved

  • Brazilian Portuguese wording, tightened throughout.

Requirements: macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later · Apple Silicon or Intel.

Crema isn't notarized by Apple, so a fresh install needs one extra step on first launch — see First launch in the README. Updating from 1.2.0 or later happens on its own.

Free and open source under GPL-3.0.
